reviewer: 개발 담당 AI의 공식 원문 대조 (not independent/blind evaluation)
method: Manual scope/field/citation review. S sufficient; C clarification; I insufficient. C and I are not sufficient answers. Targeted development sample, not population accuracy. Two dates are separate runs.
